after,holding,after,satisfaction.description:
SCOPE: in the interval (if defined) starting strictly after the first $scope_mode$ interval and spanning to the end of the execution.
TRIGGER: every point in the interval where $regular_condition$ is true.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, $post_condition$ must be false at all time points with distance <=$duration$ from the trigger (i.e., trigger, trigger+1, ..., and trigger+$duration$). Moreover, $post_condition$ must hold at the point that is at distance $duration$+1 from the trigger, that is, trigger+$duration$+1, except if the end of the interval occurs earlier.
